title_zh: 王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议
title_en: Wang Junzheng Chairs Meeting of CPC Tibet Regional Committee Standing Committee
summary_zh: 2026年7月31日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议。
summary_en: On July 31, 2026, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Regional Committee, chaired a meeting of the Standing Committee of the Regional Committee.
